description: Get multi-day flood forecast for a location with current, mean, and peak river discharge projections. Returns discharge statistics and severity assessment. Use to evaluate flood risk and timeline.

forecast_days.description: Number of forecast days to retrieve (1–92). Defaults to 16.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location in decimal degrees.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location in decimal degrees.

name: get_flood_forecast
